description.zh: 内网访问策略的应用ID集合。一条策略最多支持100个内网访问应用ID。
description.en: The IDs of applications associated with the internal network access policy. A single policy supports up to 100 application IDs.

description.zh:
内网访问策略的应用类型。取值：
- **Application**：应用。
- **Tag**：标签。
description.en:
The application type for the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Application**: Application.

- **Tag**: Tag.

description.zh: 内网访问策略的自定义用户组集合，当用户组类型为**Custom**时，必填。和用户组ID集合互斥。自定义用户组总数最多10个。
description.en: This parameter specifies a collection of custom user groups for the private network access policy. It is required when the user group type is **Custom**. This collection is mutually exclusive with the user group ID collection, and you can specify a maximum of 10 custom user groups.

description.zh: 内网访问策略描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格。
description.en: A description of the internal network access policy. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), hyphens (-), and spaces.

description.zh:
不满足安全基线的执行策略。取值：

- **Block**：拦截。
- **Observe**：观察。
description.en:
The action taken when a device does not meet the security baseline. Valid values:

- **Block**: Block access.

- **Observe**: Monitor access.

description.zh: 安全基线策略的ID。
description.en: The ID of the security baseline policy.

description.zh:
内网访问策略的修改类型。取值：
- **Cover**（默认）：使用**ApplicationIds**、**UserGroupIds**、**CustomUserAttributes**参数的值覆盖原应用ID集合、用户组ID集合、自定义用户组集合。
- **Append**：在原应用ID集合、用户组ID集合、自定义用户组集合中分别增加**ApplicationIds**、**UserGroupIds**、**CustomUserAttributes**参数中输入的值。
description.en:
The method used to update the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Cover** (default): Replace the existing application IDs, user group IDs, and custom user attributes with the values specified in **ApplicationIds**, **UserGroupIds**, and **CustomUserAttributes**.

- **Append**: Add the values specified in **ApplicationIds**, **UserGroupIds**, and **CustomUserAttributes** to the existing application IDs, user group IDs, and custom user attributes.

description.zh:
内网访问策略动作。取值：
- **Block**：阻断。
- **Allow**：允许。
description.en:
The action that the internal network access policy takes. Valid values:

- **Block**: Block access.

- **Allow**: Allow access.

description.zh:
内网访问策略ID。取值来源：
- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~)：批量查询内网访问策略。
- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~)：创建内网访问策略。
description.en:
The ID of the internal network access policy. Get this value from one of the following operations:

- [ListPrivateAccessPolices](~~ListPrivateAccessPolices~~): List internal network access policies in batches.

- [CreatePrivateAccessPolicy](~~CreatePrivateAccessPolicy~~): Create an internal network access policy.

description.zh: 内网访问策略优先级。数字1表示优先级最高。取值：1~1000，最大值为内网访问策略总数减一。
description.en: The priority of the internal network access policy. Priority 1 is the highest. Valid values: 1 to 1000. The maximum value is the total number of internal network access policies minus 1.

description.zh:
内网访问策略的状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭。
description.en:
The status of the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled.

description.zh: 内网访问标签ID集合。一条策略最多支持100个内网访问标签ID。
description.en: The IDs of tags associated with the internal network access policy. A single policy supports up to 100 tag IDs.

description.zh: 触发模板ID。
description.en: The ID of the trigger template.

description.zh: 可信进程组ID。
description.en: The IDs of trusted process groups.

description.zh:
可信进程开关状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭。
description.en:
The status of the trusted process feature. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled.

description.zh: 可信软件ID。
description.en: The IDs of trusted software.

description.zh: 内网访问策略的用户组ID集合，当用户组类型为**Normal**时，必填。和自定义用户组集合互斥。单个策略的用户组最大支持10000个，单次修改的用户组ID数量最多2000个。
description.en: The IDs of user groups associated with the internal network access policy. This parameter is required when UserGroupMode is set to Normal. This parameter is mutually exclusive with **CustomUserAttributes**. A single policy supports up to 10,000 user groups. You can update up to 2,000 user group IDs at a time.

description.zh:
内网访问策略的用户组类型。取值：
- **Normal**：普通用户组。
- **Custom**：自定义用户组。
description.en:
The user group type for the internal network access policy. Valid values:

- **Normal**: Regular user group.

- **Custom**: Custom user group.

description.zh: 零信任策略的生效起始时间，为秒级时间戳。
description.en: The start time of the zero-trust policy's effective period, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

description.zh:
生效时间开关状态。取值：
- **Enabled**：开启。
- **Disabled**：关闭。
description.en:
The status of the effective time feature. Valid values:

- **Enabled**: Enabled.

- **Disabled**: Disabled.

description.zh: 零信任策略的生效截止时间，为秒级时间戳。
description.en: The end time of the zero-trust policy's effective period, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun csas update-private-access-policy --policy-id pa-policy-63b2f1844b860000 --description '这是一条内网访问策略' --policy-action Allow --application-type Application --application-ids pa-application-f4dd77bced900000 --tag-ids tag-57c8238455b90000 --user-group-mode Normal --user-group-ids usergroup-927a4c7fee940000 --custom-user-attributes Relation=Equal IdpId=12 UserGroupType=department Value=OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉 --status Enabled --priority 1 --modify-type Cover --device-attribute-id dag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --device-attribute-action Block --trigger-template-id dag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000 --trusted-software-ids swb-xxxxxxxx --trusted-process-group-ids pg-xxxxxxxx --trusted-process-status Disabled --valid-from 0 --valid-until 1764727544 --valid-time-status Enabled --name example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun csas UpdatePrivateAccessPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --CustomUserAttributes.1.IdpId 12 --Description '这是一条内网访问策略' --CustomUserAttributes.1.Relation Equal --CustomUserAttributes.1.Value 'OU=部门1,OU=SASE钉钉' --TrustedProcessStatus Disabled --Name 'example-string' --UserGroupMode Normal --ValidTimeStatus Enabled --ValidFrom 0 --PolicyAction Allow --TrustedProcessGroupIds.1 'pg-xxxxxxxx' --Status Enabled --TrustedSoftwareIds.1 'swb-xxxxxxxx' --Priority 1 --CustomUserAttributes.1.UserGroupType department --ValidUntil 1764727544 --TriggerTemplateId 'dag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --ApplicationType Application --ModifyType Cover --UserGroupIds.1 'usergroup-927a4c7fee940000' --DeviceAttributeAction Block --TagIds.1 'tag-57c8238455b90000' --DeviceAttributeId 'dag-d3f64e8bdd4a0000' --ApplicationIds.1 'pa-application-f4dd77bced900000' --PolicyId 'pa-policy-63b2f1844b860000' --method POST --force
